summary: `resolved.json` + `shots.json` -> `shots.resolved.json` + `checks/shots.json`, `checks/stillness.json`, `checks/audit-gate.json`. Resolves the shot spans and runs every pre-render check in one pass: shot lint, W18 stillness, and the audit gate. Replaces four separate commands (`shots`, `stillness`, `audit-gate`, and the optional 050 audit step), three of which wrote nothing and one of which was optional while a gate depended on it.
